turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I have an interview on Thursday and I'm really nervous.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's normal, we can practice. Do you want to start with tell me about yourself, or with questions about your weaknesses?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold that thought, I need to talk to Grace real quick. Stay quiet until I return.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you know what kind of paint the landlord used in the kitchen?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No idea. Why, are you touching up the scuffs?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to, but if it's glossy and I use matte, it'll look patchy.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just take a chip off behind the fridge and bring it to the store. They can match it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, that's clever. Can you help me pull the fridge out later?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, I'm back. What was I saying?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi again. Ready to choose, the introduction question or the weakness one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Weaknesses. That one always trips me up.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good choice. Pick a real weakness, then explain what you're doing to improve it. Honesty plus progress works best.
